vb_textbox.text: In the choice between green and red gnomes, green will give more towards the start of the experiment, however, closer to the end of the experiment it will switch and the red gnome will give more, not exactly half way, but around 60% or 75% of the way through.In the choice between brown and purple, purple will give more at the start, but it feels like it changes more frequently and brown will sometimes give more, use your best judgement and check brown sometimes.
